'''RX-13''', also known as '''Crash''', was an [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-series pilot droid]] owned by [[Sirona Okeefe]]. Crash worked as Okeefe's co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the [[Banshee (Baudo-class)|''Banshee'']] and had a tendency to complain just about everything rather than doing his chores. He participated in an early [[Alderaanian Resistance]] mission to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] to rescue [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]].
